examples.query:
SELECT CAST(12345.678 AS decimal(10,2)) AS [SoTien],
	CAST(12345.678 AS int) AS [SoNguyen];

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(27), CAST('2026-10-31T23:59:59.999' AS datetime), 121) AS [Datetime],
	CONVERT(varchar(27), CAST('2026-10-31T23:59:59.999' AS datetime2(3)), 121) AS [Datetime2];
SELECT CAST(12.345 AS decimal(5,2)) AS [GiaTri];

SELECT CAST('00123' AS varchar(5)) AS [MaChu],
	CAST('00123' AS int) AS [MaSo];

SELECT 100 + '20' AS [CongSo],
	CAST(100 AS varchar(3)) + '20' AS [NoiChu];

SELECT CONVERT(char(10), CONVERT(date, '01/02/2026', 103), 23) AS [Ngay],
	CONVERT(char(10), TRY_CONVERT(date, '31/02/2026', 103), 23) AS [NgaySai];

SELECT CAST(5 / 2 AS decimal(5,2)) AS [DoiSau],
	CAST(5 AS decimal(5,2)) / 2 AS [DoiTruoc];
SELECT TRY_CAST(4 AS xml) AS [GiaTri];

SELECT TRY_CAST(N'123.456' AS decimal(5,2)) AS [A],
	TRY_CAST(N'x' AS decimal(5,2)) AS [B];
SELECT N'NV' + 1 AS [Ma];
SELECT N'NV' + CAST(1 AS nvarchar(10)) AS [Ma];

SELECT N'[' + TRIM(N'  An  Bình  ') + N']' AS [HaiDau],
	N'[' + LTRIM(N'  An  ') + N']' AS [Dau],
	N'[' + RTRIM(N'  An  ') + N']' AS [Cuoi],
	TRIM(N'.' FROM N'..An..') AS [BoDauCham];

SELECT LEFT(N'NV047', 2) AS [Dau],
	RIGHT(N'NV047', 3) AS [Cuoi],
	SUBSTRING(N'NV047', 3, 2) AS [Giua],
	SUBSTRING(N'NV047', 3) AS [DenCuoi];
SELECT CHARINDEX(N'a', N'ABC' COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2) AS [ViTri];

SELECT REPLACE(N'09-2026-09', N'-', N'/') AS [ThayTatCa],
	STUFF(N'NV047', 3, 3, N'***') AS [TheoViTri];
SELECT UPPER(N'Hà Nội') AS [Hoa], LOWER(N'Hà Nội') AS [Thuong];
SELECT FORMAT(CAST(1234.5 AS decimal(10, 2)), N'N2', 'vi-VN') AS [HienThi];

SELECT 10 + 5 * 2 AS [KhongNgoac],
	(10 + 5) * 2 AS [CoNgoac],
	5 / 2 AS [ChiaNguyen],
	5 % 2 AS [PhanDu];

SELECT CAST(5 / 2 AS decimal(10, 2)) AS [DoiSau],
	CAST(5 AS decimal(10, 2)) / 2 AS [DoiTruoc];

SELECT ROUND(12.345, 2) AS [Duong],
	ROUND(-12.345, 2) AS [Am],
	ROUND(12.345, 2, 1) AS [CatBo],
	ROUND(125.00, -1) AS [HangChuc];
SELECT ROUND(CAST(748.58 AS decimal(6, 2)), -3) AS [KetQua];

SELECT ABS(-12.5) AS [DoLon], POWER(2, 3) AS [LuyThua],
	POWER(2, -1) AS [CoSoNguyen],
	POWER(CAST(2 AS decimal(10, 2)), -1) AS [CoSoThapPhan],
	-5 % 2 AS [DuAm];

SELECT 10.0 / NULLIF(0, 0) AS [KhongTinhDuoc],
	10.0 / NULLIF(4, 0) AS [TinhDuoc];

SELECT CAST(50000 AS bigint) * 50000 AS [TichLon],
	ABS(CAST(-2147483648 AS bigint)) AS [DoLon];
SELECT CONVERT(char(10), DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21), 23) AS [Ngay];

SELECT YEAR(DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)) AS [Nam],
	MONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)) AS [Thang],
	DAY(DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)) AS [Ngay],
	DATEPART(quarter, DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)) AS [Quy],
	DATENAME(month, DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)) AS [TenThang];

SELECT CONVERT(char(10), DATEADD(day, 7, DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 21)), 23) AS [Sau7Ngay],
	CONVERT(char(10), DATEADD(month, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 1, 31)), 23) AS [Sau1Thang];

SELECT CONVERT(char(10), EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 1, 15)), 23) AS [ThangNay],
	CONVERT(char(10), EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 1, 15), 1), 23) AS [ThangSau];

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(33), DATETRUNC(month, CAST('2026-10-21T14:35:42' AS datetime2(0))), 126) AS [DauThang],
	CONVERT(varchar(33), DATETRUNC(hour, CAST('2026-10-21T14:35:42' AS datetime2(0))), 126) AS [DauGio];

SELECT SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(GETDATE(), 'BaseType') AS [GetDate],
	SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'BaseType') AS [CurrentTimestamp],
	SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SYSDATETIME(), 'BaseType') AS [SysDateTime],
	SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SYSUTCDATETIME(), 'BaseType') AS [Utc],
	SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), 'BaseType') AS [CoDoLech];

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(40),
	CAST('2026-10-21T08:00:00' AS datetime2(0))
		AT TIME ZONE 'SE Asia Standard Time', 126) AS [GanGioVietNam],
	CONVERT(varchar(40),
	CAST('2026-10-21T08:00:00' AS datetime2(0))
		AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'SE Asia Standard Time', 126) AS [TuUtcSangVietNam];

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(33), Moc, 126) AS [MocTrongThang9]
FROM (VALUES
	(CAST('2026-09-30T23:59:59.9999999' AS datetime2(7))),
	(CAST('2026-10-01T00:00:00' AS datetime2(7)))
) AS v(Moc)
WHERE Moc >= DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 9, 1)
	AND Moc < DATEFROMPARTS(2026, 10, 1);

SELECT Diem,
	CASE
		WHEN Diem IS NULL THEN N'Chưa có'
		WHEN Diem >= 80 THEN N'Tốt'
		WHEN Diem >= 50 THEN N'Đạt'
		ELSE N'Chưa đạt'
	END AS [XepLoai]
FROM (VALUES (85), (65), (40), (CAST(NULL AS int))) AS v(Diem)
ORDER BY Diem;

SELECT IIF(10 > 5, N'Đạt', N'Chưa đạt') AS [DieuKienDung],
	IIF(CAST(NULL AS int) > 5, N'Đạt', N'Chưa đạt') AS [DieuKienChuaBiet];

SELECT CHOOSE(2, N'Thấp', N'Vừa', N'Cao') AS [TrongPhamVi],
	CHOOSE(0, N'Thấp', N'Vừa', N'Cao') AS [NgoaiPhamVi];
